title: Austin's Quick Settlement Rejection
summary:
*   Austin convened a special public hearing concerning a proposed settlement with Coastal States-Lo Vaca Gathering Company.
*   The meeting was notably brief, concluding in just three minutes.
*   Council members promptly closed the hearing with no action taken, as Coastal States had already "totally rejected" the proposed agreement.
